_about: Your answer bank. Bob fills forms ONLY from this file or a direct reply from you. Sage uses proof_bank for match maps and cover letters. you owns this file; agents may only append to 'learned' after you says 'save'. Anything marked VERIFY needs Your check before go-live.

identity.rule: Use 'Alex' for preferred/display name fields. Use 'Alexjamin' when the field says 'legal'.

contact.street_address_rule: Only fill street address and ZIP when the field is required. VERIFY zip.

links.rule: If a 'portfolio' field exists, use your portfolio link. If only 'website', use your website. Leave GitHub blank unless required, then ask the candidate.

eligibility.relocation_note: Remote, or on-site/hybrid in your local area only
eligibility.drug_screen: VERIFY - not yet confirmed by the candidate; ask
eligibility.occasional_after_hours: Yes, occasional late calls are fine

background.rule: Never claim a tool, platform or language that is not listed here. If asked about one in has_not_used, answer No honestly. If asked about any other tool, ask the candidate.

sourcing.previously_applied_here: No (n8n already skips companies in the Applied tab)

salary._private: the candidate's real floor is deliberately NOT stored in this file. Never state a minimum or 'lowest acceptable' number anywhere.
salary.when_range_posted: Ask near the top of the posted range, rounded to the nearest $5,000
salary.would_you_accept_X: Yes if X is at or above your quoted minimum; otherwise ask
salary.minimum_acceptable_field: If a form asks for a minimum, use the low end of your quoted range and flag it to the candidate in the approval message
salary.hourly_or_contract: Do not apply - full-time salaried only. Stop and tell the candidate.

demographics.rule: Optional EEO/demographic questions: leave blank. If a choice is required, pick 'I don't wish to answer' / 'Decline to self-identify'. Never guess.

consent.standard_application_privacy_consent: Check it (data processing for this application only)
consent.anything_else_legal: Stop and ask the candidate (arbitration, non-compete, waivers, background-check authorization signatures)

files.cover_letter: Written per job by Sage at ~/job-agent/jobs/<row_id>/cover_letter.md (and .pdf)

never_guess: Any tool, platform, certification or language not listed in background
Years-of-experience counts for any specific skill
Legal agreements, waivers, arbitration, non-compete, signatures
Criminal, credit, or financial history questions
SSN, date of birth, bank details (no application needs these at this stage)
Essay or short-answer questions about the candidate's own process, opinions, or stories
Any question where the honest answer is unclear

proof_bank._rule: Sage may only cite proof from this list or the resume PDF. No invented numbers, clients, or results.
proof_bank.project_1: One or two sentences on a real project, at the level you can defend in an interview.
proof_bank.project_2: Another real project. No numbers you can't back up.
proof_bank.job_agent: This application system itself: n8n lead pipeline from Remotive, RemoteOK, We Work Remotely and Hacker News, AI fit scoring, a coordinator agent that drafts, a browser agent that fills forms, and the candidate approving every submission.
